identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of GC012F Injection in Subjects With Refractory Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 1/2 Clinical Study of GC012F Injection in Subjects With Refractory Systemic Lupus Erythematosus

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a single-arm, open-label, multicenter, phase 1/2 clinical study to assess the safety and efficacy of GC012F Injection in subjects with refractory Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE).
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a single-arm, open-label, multicenter, phase 1/2 clinical study to assess the safety and efficacy of GC012F Injection in subjects with refractory SLE；The dose-escalation phase 1 study aims to assess the safety of GC012F Injection and determine the Recommended Phase II Dose (RP2D). The phase 2 study aims to determine the efficacy and safety of GC012F Injection at the RP2D in patients with refractory SLE and assess the pharmacokinetics (PK) and pharmacodynamics (PD) characteristics.

interventions.name: GC012F Injection
interventions.description: GC012F Injection is an autologous chimeric antigen receptor T cell therapy targeting both BCMA and CD19

primaryOutcomes.description: Phase 1 study：Proportions of subjects with DLT within 28 days after infusion.
Phase 2 study：Proportion of subjects achieving SRI-4 response at Week 48.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Proportions of subjects with AEs after the infusion;
Proportions of subjects achieving SLE Responder Index (SRI)-4 response by timepoint;

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Definitions of Remission in SLE (DORIS) rate
secondaryOutcomes.description: Proportions of subjects achieving remission according to the DORIS by timepoint;

secondaryOutcomes.measure: lupus low disease activity state (LLDAS) rate
secondaryOutcomes.description: Proportions of subjects achieving LLDAS by timepoint;
Proportions of subjects achieving CR by timepoint;
Maintenance time of remission according to the DORIS;
